item.title: Niger launches 2027 Bac and BTS pre-registration
item.description: Online platforms open October 29 for students seeking state diplomas, with new subject integrations.

item.title: Türkiye seeks deeper Niger partnership
item.description: Ankara wants to boost cooperation in defense, health, education, energy, and mining.

item.title: Niger officials attend peace prayer in Maradi
item.description: Maradi's regional secretary general and a presidential advisor joined prayers for stability.

item.title: Algeria to send troops to Niger
item.description: Algerian parliament approved the deployment of troops to Niger on October 25.

item.title: Algeria sends troops to Niger to protect energy interests
item.description: President Tebboune announced the deployment after parliament approved intervention on October 25.
